# Code of conduct

Work in this forge as in a good smithy: respect people, their time and their work.

- Be kind and direct. Critique code and ideas, never people.
- Give credit, and ask before you take.
- Help newcomers find their way around the workshop.
- No harassment, discrimination or hostile behaviour of any kind.

Report problems to the maintainer: [@Sarverott](https://github.com/Sarverott).
Maintainers may remove comments, commits or contributors that break these rules.
